answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Shares & Investments Question ID: 7489 Country: India Title: What is dividend which comes as a result of investment ? Is it allowed to take the dividend from the company where we have invested? Question: Assalamualaikum wr wb, What is dividend which comes as a result of investment ? Is it allowed to take the dividend from the company where we have invested? Answer ID: 7489 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 880/880=M/1429) It is permissible to receive the profits of investment as per the settled agreement provided you invested in lawful business and have settled the deal with the company as per the norms and rules of partnership or muzarabah . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
